ITEM 1. BUSINESS
Overview of the registrant's operations in industrial automation.

Concentration of suppliers
We purchase a significant portion of our semiconductor components from Example Industries AG. For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, purchases from Example Industries AG accounted for 14% of our total purchases. Example Industries AG is our sole source supplier for certain power modules.

Customers
Our largest customer is a distributor. We also market our controllers through resellers; resellers are not named in this report. Boilerplate: the Company's customers include various Example Industries AG competitors, but we do not rely on any of them.

The Company's management discussion mentions Example Industries AG in the context of a patent cross-license that is unrelated to any customer or supplier relationship.
